title: Health conditions
summary: Published county and tract estimates of chronic conditions and mental health, when available.
limits: These are modeled PLACES estimates for the stated adult population and year. They do not diagnose an individual or establish a cause.

title: Prevention and access
summary: Published prevention measures and two distinct insurance estimates.
limits: ACS uninsured describes all ages in a household survey; PLACES lack of insurance models adults aged 18–64. They are different measures and cannot be compared as one series. A nearby health center does not establish access.

title: Health care resources
summary: Published workforce and hospital counts with mapped health center and nursing-home locations.
limits: Counts are not per-person rates. Facility locations do not show service areas or capacity.

title: Community conditions
summary: Census-published population and community characteristics alongside income, broadband, vehicle access, and housing costs.
limits: Measures describe different populations and periods. ACS margins of error are 90% margins.

title: Food environment
summary: Published county measures of supermarket access and authorized food outlets.
limits: Observation years differ across these measures. Outlet counts do not establish affordability or travel time.

title: Environment
summary: EPA annual county AQI summaries and TRI reporting-facility locations.
limits: Counties without a reporting monitor have no AQI value. TRI locations do not measure exposure or health effects.

title: Medicare use and spending
summary: Original Medicare beneficiary counts, spending, care use, and readmissions.
limits: These measures describe Original Medicare beneficiaries, not all residents.
